cohort: The cohort consisted of primiparous women giving birth between 2014 and 2019, including 829 women with CHD and 4137 matched controls without CHD.
finding: Pregnancy complications are more common in women with CHD, and the mWHO classification is associated with maternal complications and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were more common in women with CHD compared to controls, and high mWHO class (III, IV) was associated with an increased odds of caesarean section.
